title: The Moment He Realised He Made The Worst Decision Ever
description:
On July 1st, 2022, an officer noticed a male and a female walking on the wrong side of the road. He quickly exited his police vehicle and attempted to talk to them, but the male continued to act aggressively and threaten him. The male continued to disobey the cop, even after the cop's repeated commands, which escalated the situation. Soon, more officers arrived on the scene to provide assistance. The suspect was already in a lot of trouble by this point. Usually, suspects verbally abuse and resist the police while being handcuffed, which only worsens their situation. The suspect was extremely uncooperative, constantly arguing with the cops. He would soon be interrogated by one of the officers. The officers were about to put him inside the police vehicle, but it wouldn't be easy. The suspect became very aggressive while talking to the officer and started banging his head on the windows repeatedly. The male finally cooperated with the officers and provided his full name. The cops didn't find anything significant in his bag, but they confiscated the stroller for investigation. The suspect didn't provide any additional information about the woman to the officers, but he was ready to cooperate with the next procedures. The male was charged with the following offences: pedestrian on a roadway, failure to obey an officer, and resisting arrest.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
